build.name: apt build-essential + pip install the acquired source (+ pinned deps)
build.cmd: apt-get -qq update >/dev/null && apt-get -qq install -y build-essential >/dev/null 2>&1; pip install -q numpy . 2>&1 | grep -v -i 'notice\|warning' | tail -2; python -c 'import sys; print(sys.version.split()[0])'

runs.name: verify (Techne harness, oracle-backed; same-container install + run)
runs.cmd: apt-get -qq update >/dev/null && apt-get -qq install -y build-essential >/dev/null 2>&1; pip install -q numpy . 2>&1 | grep -v -i 'notice\|warning' | tail -2 >/dev/null; python $HARNESS/verify.py

notes: Runs the package's own test suite (Vallado's tcppver.out verification vectors) and prints the count. The C++ accelerator is compiled (build-essential installed in the run container, recorded).
